notes.title: Patch 1.31 - HUD Icons And Graphics
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.31 adds a few HUD icons, making the game slightly less austere in appearance.[/p][p]Obviously this is cosmetic- no changes to the story.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.30 - Rodent Content Update
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.30 adds the portrait for your optional pet, the Black Rat. [/p][p]To enable it in an existing save or when migrating from DEMO, just use Skill - Fast Travel.[/p][p][/p][p]PS. The game mostly uses Vexed Enigma assets, but this particular portrait for the rat is original and it was more work than it looks.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.29c - Hellish Difficulty Level/Ultra Realism
notes.content: [p]If you feel that the game is too easy and too unrealistic for your character, the patch 1.29c allows you to try the hellish and very realistic difficulty level, above just merely realistic/harsh.[/p][p][/p][p]Would you like your character to heal from minor wounds for a week, if not longer, to feel the realism of your in-game pain? (or, what is more likely, to just die?)[/p][p]Patch 1.29c, while it's not mandatory, gives you such an option.[/p][p][/p][p]Yes, it's still possible to complete the game, if you are wise and lucky and patient- but truly hellish.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.29- Somewhat Better Logo, Menu And UI
notes.content: [p]Patch 1.29 improves some graphics (logo, menu, credits) and the user interface. [/p][p]Special thanks to all friends- without you such changes wouldn't be possible.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.28- A Few New Icons
notes.content: This is a pretty minor patch that mainly improves a few icons.

notes.title: Patch 1.27 - Western Wall, Contaminated Lake
notes.content:
Patch 1.27 adds two minor maps to the west from the Border Checkpoint and the Refugee Camp Ruins.
These are not very important, but allow you a slightly different way to find Julia's Camp.
No changes to the main story.

notes.title: Patch 1.25 - Car Repair And Clean Water
notes.content:
This minor patch improves the quest about repair of the car (the one near the Church).

It also allows you to enjoy clean water in your house (assuming that you own the house and do some repairs).

notes.title: Patch 1.23- Ashley And Megan
notes.content:
Minor patch 1.23 adds a new minor character, trader and a side-quest.
Also, it solves a major bug with the medical bag (permanently disappearing map).
There are no changes to the main story.

notes.title: Patch 1.20 – The First True Major Update is Here!
notes.content:
This isn't just a patch: it's a turning point. Version 1.20 brings the game to a whole new level with fresh content, deeper choices, and more to explore than ever before.

- More quests to challenge your skills and shape your story

- More endings — all shall die someday, but parts of your dark fate are in your hands

- More ways to upgrade your farm (if you decide to own it, of course...)

- Longer gameplay depending on your path and decisions

- Countless new details and hidden interactions waiting to be discovered


Whether you're a returning player or just starting your journey, Patch 1.20 is the best time to dive in.

notes.title: Patch 1.15 - The Refugee Camp Ruins, Expanded
notes.content:
Patch 1.15 adds a few details, among them partially accessible "Dead Zone" of the Refugee Camp.
No changes to the main story, fully compatible saves.

notes.title: Patch 1.13 - Tony The Homeless
notes.content:
The patch adds a very minor character and a quest: Tony The Homeless.
It's not important for the main storyline.

notes.title: Patch 1.12 - Poisonous Bath
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.12[/b] introduces a new way to clean your character without soap or clean water — by using the cheapest public pool in Foxtown (added to the Red Engine Salvage location).
But beware: your character’s health may suffer for it.

Patch 1.12 also includes minor improvements to several icons and graphics, and adds a small side quest.
There are no changes to the main story.

notes.title: Patch 1.11.1 - Yes The Game Is Still Alive
notes.content:
While patch 1.11.1 is relatively minor, and changes mainly some details at the start of the game (nothing that could impact the plot) & fixes bugs- I just wanted to thank all players for their support and interest.

The game is finished, but not dead- and you can still expect support.

notes.title: Patch 1.11 - Map to The Abbey
notes.content:
This minor patch allows for alternative way to find the Abbey- just by buying a proper map.
This changes nothing in the previously existing ways to progress the plot.

notes.title: Patch 1.10 - Overall Improvements
notes.content:
Patch 1.10 mostly polishes various content added as smaller updates after 1.09.

In particular, you can now "free" the dissatisfied communist from the commune, and even add them as a companion (but no, that's not a romance option) for a while. Whether you want to deal with it is a separate matter, but there is an important choice that can be made.

notes.title: Patch 1.09 - Small Companions Rework
notes.content:
Patch 1.09 slightly improves companions, especially Julia and Nadia.

More interactions are possible- from giving them more food or buying them candy, to improving relations with them by the way of giving them (some, and only once) books. It only offers more options, nothing existing was removed.

notes.title: Patch 1.08 - Small Romance And Banking
notes.content:
Patch 1.08 allows you a small additional "romance" on the side, assuming that you decide to save two sisters from slavery. But beware, your main love interest, if any, may not be pleased.

It also adds very basic banking - you can now deposit and withdraw money from the loan shark and his "bank". This may be slightly useful if you are bad at savings or want a few dollars protected from bandits and in-game events. It allows you to withdraw even when "too tired to talk."

notes.title: Patch 1.07 - Autosave
notes.content:
The patch 1.07 introduces autosave.
It was obvious to include, and I apologize to all players for not having it working from the start.

notes.title: Patch 1.06.2 - Yet Another Minor Bugfix
notes.content: Patch 1.06.2 is yet another minor bugfix to collisions, moonshine use, etc.

notes.title: Patch 1.06.1 - Better Stability!
notes.content:
Patch that improves overall stability of the game, fixes some events that possibly caused game to freeze (for some players and at random time).

Usually I would classify something like that as minor update, not major one, but I heard many complains. So I want this patch note to be especially visible.

Hopefully it works well - feedback is welcome.

notes.title: Patch 1.06 - Better Storyline Flow
notes.content:
Main story now moves slightly slower, with the Abbey appearing (slightly) later.
Price of the house is slightly increased.
Small side-quest added (potential assassination of the witch).

notes.title: Patch 1.05.3
notes.content: Minor improvement in a minor side quest ("wizard" Sandro Alastor).

notes.title: Patch 1.05.2 - very minor language improvements
notes.content: Some instances of weird grammar solved, minor.

notes.title: Patch 1.05- the American Way
notes.content:
Patch 1.05 adds sidequest south from the Abbey, and a way to buy (or burn!) American flag for your post-apocalyptic house.

If you want, that is. It's not mandatory.

This patch also gives you alternative way to deal with various family issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.04 - Embrace Civilization, Wash Yourself!
notes.content:
The patch 1.04 makes needs of the character deeper, especially on harsh difficulty.
Use soap or perish like a disgusting, smelly sewer rat.

notes.title: Patch 1.03 - minor bugs fixed, used soap added
notes.content: The patch 1.03 fixes minor bugs and adds "used soap", as well as some other minor items.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 - Bags of Potatoes, Books and Details
notes.content:
Patch 1.02 adds some depth to books and a small quest to the Abbey.

It also resolves the issue with bags of potatoes.

Saves should remain compatible.

notes.title: Patch 1.01, soap and washing
notes.content:
Version 1.01 includes... ability to buy a bathtub and wash with soap (in some places). 
Minor changes, all saves should work perfectly fine.

notes.title: Patch 1.00.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.00.2 fixes minor issues and introduces soap. 
While soap may be important for the plot, it shouldn't damage existing saves.

notes.title: Patch 1.00.1
notes.content:
Patch 1.00.1 solves minor typos, grammar mistakes and language issues . Surely there may be more, and all shall be solved in time.

Bug reports and very welcome, and I try to be very responsive.
It's certainly a lesson about attention to detail as a sole dev who is not a native speaker in English. And yes: in the future I shall use spellcheckers more often.

Note, that some characters may just have a weird manner of speaking (Sylvia and her overuse of "like", as an example).
